channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Trump ramps up denaturalization push with 2026 quota targeting naturalized citizens
item.description: Internal USCIS guidance reportedly calls for 100 to 200 denaturalization referrals per month, signaling a sharp escalation that experts say collides with legal limits and historical practice.

item.title: Rights group warns masked immigration raids are spreading fear and undermining accountability
item.description: Human Rights Watch says unidentified federal agents are carrying out arrests across the country in ways it argues violate U.S. human rights obligations and erode the rule of law.

item.title: Trump’s ‘warrior dividend’ raises questions about funding, housing support, and care for service members
item.description: The president announced $1,776 checks for about 1.5 million troops before Christmas, but reporting shows the money was repurposed from congressionally approved housing funds rather than a new benefit.

item.title: House vote advances SPEED Act as 11 Democrats join Republicans to weaken NEPA protections
item.description: Climate and frontline groups warn the permitting bill would gut public oversight, fast track polluting projects, and undermine one of the nation’s foundational environmental laws.
